_doc: Real components for passive DOF at exo scale. Companion to docs/research/passive_dof_hardware.md (read it for the reasoning). Units mm, N, N.m, g. 'conf' = where each number comes from: 'catalogue' = read from the manufacturer's PDF table listed in 'src' (fetched 2026-10-15); 'distributor' = a reseller / trade page (confirm); 'memory' = from memory, NOT checked - confirm before CAD; 'est' = my calculation (shown in the doc). Model envelope rule (CLAUDE.md 'Manufacturable joints only'): a guide occupies height H above its mounting face, footprint W x (L_block + travel) for the rail, plus a mounting plate (>= 1.0-1.5 mm); a radial (skin-normal) guide stands up by L_block + travel.

sources.THK_RSX: https://tech.thk.com/en/products/pdfs/en_a01_264.pdf (THK general catalogue A1, models RSX-SM/M/NM dimension + load table)
sources.THK_RSR: https://tech.thk.com/en/products/pdfs/en_a01_268.pdf (THK A1, models RSR2N/3M/3N/3WM/3WN/14WVM; RSR5M-15M are no longer in these pages - RSX is THK's current 5-15 mm stainless miniature)
sources.HIWIN_MG: https://damencnc.com/userdata/file/3455-3_HIWIN_MGN_and_MGW_Product_Catalog_2023.pdf (HIWIN GW-11-5-EN-2207, tables 3.76 loads, 3.79 block dims, 3.81 rail dims)
sources.IGUS_DRYLIN_N: https://www.igus.com/contentData/Product_Files/Download/pdf/6-4%20DryLin%20N%202016%20Section.pdf (drylin N system table + NS-01-17 / NW-02-17 tables)
sources.REPO_HW: docs/HARDWARE.md, docs/research/ring_and_shell_hardware.md (MR117 / KAA15XL0 / CRBT305A already researched)

linear_guides.notes: smallest made; loads tens of N; same 2.5 H as LWLF2 (Design World / IKO). Block L and loads: memory only, confirm.
lowest section height on the market (IKO claim). Block length not in the source (memory ~ 7-9 mm, confirm). Loads ~100 N class (memory).

linear_guides.conf: distributor (C, C0, rail W); memory (H 4, W 8: confirm)

linear_guides.notes: sold only mounted on its rail
smallest single block that carries the 25 N.m MVP2 moment; 13 mm tall alone

linear_guides.friction: plain (iglidur on hard-anodised Al, mu ~0.1-0.25 - memory)
linear_guides.notes: 17 mm wide flat rail; low loads; lengths NW-22-17-30/40 for more moment

linear_guides.conf: distributor (memory: rail 8.5 wide each, 1.5 mm rollers)
linear_guides.notes: stroke ~ half the rail length minus cage; you make both carriers; no recirculation -> travel limited, no better than a miniature ball guide in height

slide_and_spin.pn: iglidur J sleeve, e.g. JSM-0608-10 (6 x 8 x 10) - memory, confirm
slide_and_spin.make_buy: buy sleeve, make Ti/steel rod (hard anodised / TiN / 1.4034)
slide_and_spin.notes: most compact slide+spin; keep L/d >= 1.5 to avoid drawer jamming
smallest RJUM in stock listings is 8 mm; plain iglidur sleeves go smaller

slide_and_spin.pn: ST6 stroke bush (ball cage, linear + rotary, finite stroke)
slide_and_spin.make_buy: buy; shaft must be hardened (>= HRC 58): no Ti rod

slide_and_spin.dof: P only (carries torque about the axis)
slide_and_spin.notes: use when the translation must transmit torque about its own axis (e.g. along-arm slide carrying humeral rotation)

rotary_bearings.notes: O20 v5 hub pair, 12.25 mm stack incl. encoder + cap
passive pin joint (no encoder): two 2.5-3 mm plates -> ~6 mm stack

rotary_bearings.pn: IKO CRBT305A crossed-roller ring (30 x 41 x 5)
iglidur GSM sleeve + GTM thrust washers on an integral Ti pin (v4 joint)
rotary_bearings.notes: a passive pin without encoder/cap: two 2 mm plates + 0.15 washer ~ 4.5-5 mm

flexures_est._formula: fixed-guided leaf: sigma = 3 E t d / L^2  ->  L = sqrt(3 E t d / sigma_allow); stiffness per leaf k = 12 E I / L^3, I = b t^3 / 12; parasitic shortening ~ 0.6 d^2 / L. sigma_allow = fatigue design stress (est, not a datasheet value).
flexures_est.make_buy: make: wire EDM from Ti / spring-steel plate (job shop), or laser-cut shim + clamp blocks; POM machined

parallelogram_4bar._formula: swing theta = asin(d / l), parasitic = l (1 - cos theta) = ~ d^2 / (2 l)
parallelogram_4bar.envelope: in the skin plane (pins skin-normal): height = one passive pin stack ~5-6.5 mm, footprint l + 2 boss radii x (2 links + spacing). Skin-normal travel (pins parallel to skin, links near-flat): height = 2 d + pin boss (~4-5) -> +-3: ~10 mm, +-6: ~16-17 mm

planar_RR_parallel_to_J3.note: two extra pins parallel to J3 = planar RRR with J3: gives the same 2 in-plane translations as 2 slides in J3's plane. l1 = l2 = 20 covers +-13 x +-9.2 with the elbow kept 48-134 deg (>= 46 deg from fold/stretch); l 15: 76-152 deg (28 deg margin). Arm twist = q3 + qa + qb (sense the passive pins or accept). Height ~ one passive pin stack 5-6.5 mm; footprint ~ 2 l + bosses (~48 x 20 mm swept).

sarrus.note: +-3 mm with 8 mm links: 8.5 mm (collapsed, phi 20 deg) to 14.5 mm (extended) incl. 2 x 1.5 plates; knees stick out ~7.5 mm each side. 6 pins. Not better than a near-flat parallelogram.

scissor_lift.note: collapses to ~6-7 mm but needs a sliding foot (a prismatic joint anyway) and is singular near flat (foot force = F / tan phi): jam-prone when the arm pushes from the collapsed end.

a_one_translation_along_arm.best: THK RSR3M or HIWIN MGN03C (ball), H 4.0 on a 1.5 plate = 5.5 mm, rail 3 x 2.6, block 8 x 12; rail length = 12 + 2 x travel + 2 (+-13 -> 40 mm); ~3.5 g. MVP1 only (pitch moment 0.29 N.m one block, 2.1 N.m two blocks). Lower: IKO LWLF2/LWL1 H 2.5 (fragile). Plain: igus drylin N17 H 6, 17 wide.
a_one_translation_along_arm.MVP2_25Nm: two parallel MGN05C rails 30 mm apart (C0 840 N x 0.03 m = 25 N.m) at H 6, or one MGN12H (H 13)

b_two_in_plane_at_cuff.best: two RSR3M / MGN03C stacked crosswise: 4 + 1 (adapter) + 4 + 1.5 base = 10.5 mm; footprint ~40 x 33 mm for +-13 x +-9.2; ~10 g. Revolute alternative: planar RR (l 20) on passive pins, 5-6.5 mm tall, ~48 x 20 mm swept, carries MVP2 tilting moments better.
b_two_in_plane_at_cuff.too_tall: MGN05C x 2 = 13-14.5 mm (uses the whole 14 mm pass band)

c_radial_pm3.best: no guide: cuff liner compliance (6-8 mm foam / TPU lattice, est.) or a near-flat parallelogram / Ti leaf pad ~9-10 mm tall, ~30 mm long. A miniature guide standing up is 12 + 6 = 18 mm (RSR3M) - not buildable in the band.

c_radial_pm6.best: nothing real fits the 14 mm band: guide 24 mm (RSR3M), near-flat parallelogram ~16-17 mm, Ti leaf ~15 mm with 34-42 mm leaves. Verdict: not buildable at the size modelled.

d_slide_plus_spin.best: iglidur J plain sleeve on a 6 mm hard-coated rod: sleeve O8 x 10-12 in an O11-12 boss (memory part no. JSM-0608-10, confirm); rolling option THK ST stroke bush O12 x 19 on a hardened rod (memory). Ball spline is slide-only (blocks spin).
